learner_operation: Infer two elementary column additions that create two zeros in one row of a 3x3 matrix, using a specified unchanged pivot column. Learners must obtain multipliers from A and B, not recover the intended pair from distractor multiplicities.

fixed_features.feature: 3x3 matrices, two column additions, specified unchanged pivot column
fixed_features.justification: All ten practice sources and canonical e-8051 use this same operation and workload.

fixed_features.feature: Five choices with a single correct operation pair
fixed_features.justification: Every complete observed practice bank uses one radio selection among five pairs.
These make both requested additions meaningful and preserve the observed easy arithmetic.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Each of three columns and three rows; update wording and dependent matrices together.
answer_roles.observed: All nine combinations explicitly constructed and checked; fresh sampling varies these roles.

answer_roles.role: Signs and magnitudes of both multipliers
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Positive/negative integral multipliers for either target column.
answer_roles.observed: All four sign patterns present in independent sample; profile-dependent rejection also observed.

answer_roles.role: Correct pair relative to distractor multiplicities
answer_roles.eligible_variation: The correct pair need not combine the most frequent individual operations; distractor construction should not reveal correctness without matrices.
answer_roles.observed: Five profiles leak the correct pair through a recognizable option frequency signature. Source examples do not justify freezing this answer-bearing arrangement.

coverage.case: All row/pivot cases and source banks
coverage.result: Nine explicit row/pivot cases; all ten source practice banks and canonical values replayed. q-130614 uses equivalent q-130609 profile.

coverage.case: Independent samples versus exact runner batch
coverage.result: 216 fresh records across nine profiles; five runner records assessed separately. 102 sampled and one batch item expose the conditional shortcut.

counterfactuals.change: A[0][0] 4 -> -4, same pivot 2 and remaining data; first multiplier -2 -> +2.
counterfactuals.expected: First multiplier must flip sign; B and solution update and old pair is rejected.
counterfactuals.observed: Prompt and B, first operation, both solution stages and conclusion update; former correct operation pair is a distractor and native grader rejects it.

counterfactuals.change: Off-target A[1][0] 1 -> 8; target row and pivot unchanged.
counterfactuals.expected: Correct mathematical pair preserved; off-target computed matrix entries change.
counterfactuals.observed: Correct operation pair and whole bank preserved; prompt/B and intermediate matrix entries change; grader still accepts only the same mathematical pair. IDs change as content changes.
counterfactuals.justification: Changing a non-target-row entry of a target column does not change the ratio used to clear the target row.

counterfactuals.change: Same A and zeroed row, pivot column changes from C1 to C2.
counterfactuals.expected: Retained and modified column roles, all dependent matrices, prompt and explanations follow new pivot.
counterfactuals.observed: Prompt, target labels, B, operations, pivot-coordinate explanation and native correct choice follow the chosen pivot.
counterfactuals.justification: Source questions already vary the given unchanged column.

stages_examined: fresh-practice eligibility and difficulty-first learner selection rules
delivery.result: 216/216 independent samples and 5/5 batch records survive delivery against captured basis 5581. Option-only shortcut remains 102/102 conditional sample predictions and 1/1 conditional batch predictions. Fresh positive-easy-weight selection can deliver these defects; learner-specific exclusions may remove individual items.

limitations: No finite sample rules out all possible shortcuts.
Future database IDs, live policy weights and learner history are unavailable; selection analysis uses inspected rules and explicit hypothetical identity/history scenarios.
Captured inventory consists of ten original source questions and no generated records; affected-inventory.json is empty on that verified basis, not because generated records were left untested.
No database writes or publication performed.
